cards.imageAlt: Micro-burst，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you say something about this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 可以说一下这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText:
This picture is mainly about micro-burst.
It usually contains three stages: headwind, downdraft and tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这张图片主要是有关微下击暴流的。微下击暴流通常包含三个阶段：逆风、下沉气流和顺风。

cards.audioText: In what weather conditions do you think you will encounter the micro-burst?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的天气条件下，你会遇到微下击暴流？
cards.referenceText:
As far as I know, the micro-burst usually appears in thunderstorm or rain shower.
It is very dangerous to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
据我所知，微下击暴流一般出现在雷暴或者强降雨天气中。
它对飞行安全十分危险。

cards.audioText: What may occur if you fly through a micro-burst?
cards.audioTextZh: 穿越微下击暴流时会发生什么？
cards.referenceText:
When flying through a micro-burst, the aircraft will become very unstable and difficult to control.
At the beginning, the aircraft speed and altitude will increase rapidly.
When the aircraft passes the center of the micro-burst, tailwind will cause airspeed decrease, and the altitude will be lost suddenly.
cards.referenceTextZh:
当飞机穿过微下击暴流时，飞机将变得很不稳定，很难控制。
最初，速度和高度会快速上升。
飞机通过微下击暴流中心时，顺风会使空速和高度突然下降。
